name: Building AI into Quality Management: SPC, CAPA, ISO 9001 and IATF 16949
description: Follow one composite tier-1 supplier under controlled shipping through six quality jobs: an SPC layer that routes every signal without moving limits, an 8D grounded in evidence, PFMEA linkage and predictive quality, warranty coding behind a safety bypass, validating vendor AI and an AI vision station, and the AI-in-QMS procedure. Every exercise uses synthetic plant data, and every module ends in a Decision Lab.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Manufacturing and Industrial Operations

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building AI into Quality Management: SPC, CAPA, ISO 9001 and IATF 16949

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Evaluate an SPC monitoring layer on a replay, comparing run rules with a multivariate or drift detector on detection delay and false alarms, routing each signal to the reaction plan without moving control limits, and auditing an automatically chosen capability distribution
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Build and evaluate a retrieval-grounded 8D draft in which every number traces to a record, D4 explains both occurrence and escape and how each was verified, and a similar past 8D is not copied
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Analyze PFMEA, control-plan and work-instruction linkage with a script and an LLM, reject unsupported rating changes, and decide whether a predictive-quality model may enter the control plan
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate a warranty-narrative classifier against expert codes and place a deterministic safety bypass ahead of any model so that product-safety decisions and US reporting clocks never wait on a model
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Analyze requirements documents with AI by diffing customer-specific requirements revisions against a gold list and checking audit findings for edition-correct ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 citations
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Validate vendor AI for a stated intended use with thresholds fixed before testing, decide go or no-go with re-test triggers, and qualify an AI vision station on plant parts, including borderline ones, before it is credited as a detection control
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate a quality AI business case and a management-review narrative by separating booked cost-of-poor-quality reductions from avoided temporary costs and freed hours, net of run costs, and by reading monthly and rolling ppm correctly
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Create an AI-in-QMS procedure and a release decision for one quality AI use, and test the procedure against scenarios from the course
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes
